verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents an agent-testing feature that verifies conversational responses, tool usage, and multi-turn outcomes before deployment, and it can turn real conversations into test cases. That gives pre-production validation, but nothing shows a separate sandbox or staging environment, or isolation of test runs from production data and live tool or webhook side effects. The 'sandboxed environment' mention refers only to running custom JavaScript tools, not to a test environment. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging workspace or environment, explicit isolation of test runs from production data and integrations, mock tool or webhook support during tests, and independent hands-on corroboration.
